meta.title: Act 1 — Land: Embervale
meta.note: The five main quests of Act 1 (game-story.md §4, issue #143). Ordering is `prerequisites` and nothing else: `arc` is a journal heading, array order means nothing, and no counter anywhere says which act the player is in — the act boundary is the flags `sea-revealed` and `act-1-complete` that the last quest sets.
meta.towns-stay-in-core: Act 1 adds no towns. `town:encampment`, `town:redbriar` and `town:stonewatch` ship in core and are referenced from here — the road planner routes one trunk and two spurs, so those three are the ground settlements the world has (game-story.md §1 rule 4).
